d: Unidentified vocalizations echoing across desolate ridges, crushed timber pathways, and biological traces that defy known zoological classifications. In this definitive multi-season expedition, world-class researchers and field analysts turn to hard science, relentlessly dedicated to testing the unexplained Bigfoot proof and decoding anomalous markers scattered across America's densest forests. Leveraging advanced acoustic arrays to record low-frequency infrasound, high-resolution thermal imaging to track nocturnal movement, and precision eDNA water sampling to pinpoint cryptic genetics,…
